newsitem.title: UK: Two Euro refiners restore runs, others undecided.
newsitem.headline: Two Euro refiners restore runs, others undecided.

text.p: European refineries are feeling more confident about profit margins and two have decided to restore crude runs after cuts early this month.
Texaco Netherlands will return to full capacity on Thursday at the 400,000 barrel per day Nerefco refinery it shares with British Petroleum, a trader familiar with the refinery said.
Texaco, which controls 35 percent of the Pernis and Europoort complex, cut crude runs by 12.5 percent on March 6.
British Petroleum, which controls 65 percent of the refinery, was understood to be closely examining the situation, according to industry sources.
Esso Slagen also confirmed it restored runs late last week at its 100,000 bpd refinery in Norway, having cut runs by 15 percent on March 10.
Other refiners were also examining the possibility of resuming normal capacity crude runs, but so far the run cuts introduced in early March were still effective.
Margins for a complex Rotterdam refinery have risen to $1.14 a barrel compared with 80 cents at the beginning of the month, according to Reuters price data using standard product yields.
Less sophisticated hydroskimmer units were still in negative territory of -42 cents.
Refinery run cuts may have helped support oil products in recent days but traders have also cited strong Asian demand that has been pulling material east and thinning European supplies.
Around 500,000 tonnes of Russian gas oil and 250,000 tonnes of heavy fuel are heading for Asia, they said.
Shell is still cutting runs by 12-15 percent at its 350,000 bpd Rotterdam refinery, which has a nameplate capacity of 374,000 bpd, a trader close to the company said on Thursday.
Daewoo said a 15 percent cut at its 60,000 bpd Universal refinery in Antwerp also remains effective because of continued weakness in the straight run fuel market.
INPC's Whitegate plant in Ireland was still running about 80 percent of its 65,000 bpd capacity, it said.
